COMMAND — Text ▸
1You type a message and press send
2APEX checks your identity and permission level
3Your message is sent to the AI model with your personal context
4The AI generates a response (typically under 3 seconds)
5The response appears in the conversation thread
6If an action is needed, an approval card appears before it runs
COMMAND — Voice ▸
1You press the mic button (or V key on desktop)
2Your browser captures audio from your microphone
3Speech is converted to text in real time
4The text follows the same path as a typed message
5The response appears in your conversation thread
AGENT TASK ▸
1A task is created — either by you or suggested by APEX
2You approve it before anything runs
3APEX works through the task one step at a time (max 10 steps)
4Each step that needs the AI checks in with the model
5If something goes wrong, the task stops safely and reports back
6When complete, results appear in ACTIONS and the activity log
INTELLIGENCE ▸
1APEX regularly scans your data for patterns and opportunities
2Each finding is scored for confidence and relevance
3Supporting evidence is attached so you can verify it
4Findings appear in the INTELLIGENCE page with full context
5You can expand any finding to see the full reasoning chain
PROACTIVE ▸
1A scheduled trigger fires (time-based or event-based)
2APEX checks whether this concerns you specifically
3A notification is created and linked to your account only
4It appears in your ACTIONS queue ready for review

Emergency Access Protocol
Emergency Account Access
Temporarily access a User's private data under explicit audit conditions. This action is logged and the User is notified.
Emergency access grants Master temporary read access to a specific User's private data scope. The access reason is recorded, the User receives a notification, and the access is audited. This does not bypass server-side privacy boundaries.
